questions: What is the B.Tech admission process and eligibility at SBJITMR?
What is the admission process?
B.Tech eligibility
answer: For AY 2024-25, B.Tech admissions at SBJITMR, Nagpur are based on MHT-CET and JEE Main. Eligibility (Maharashtra state candidature): Indian citizen; passed 10+2/equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects plus one listed qualifying subject, with a minimum of 45% in the specified subjects together (40% for Maharashtra State reserved-category/EWS/PwD candidates); must have appeared in all PCM MHT-CET 2024 subjects and obtained a non-zero score. Alternative qualifications: a minimum three-year Engineering and Technology diploma with 45% marks (40% for the stated reserved/EWS/PwD candidates), or a three-year D.Voc. in the same/allied sector. (Official source: SBJITMR Mandatory Disclosure 2024-25 — https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Mandatory-Disclosure-2024-25-Final.pdf)

questions: What is the M.Tech admission process and eligibility at SBJITMR?
answer: For AY 2024-25, M.Tech (Electronics Engineering) admissions at SBJITMR, Nagpur are based on GATE (and GPAT for the relevant pharmacy field). Eligibility: Indian citizen; a bachelor degree in the relevant Engineering and Technology or Pharmacy field from an AICTE/Central/State Government-approved institution (or equivalent) with at least 50% (45% for the stated Maharashtra reserved-category/EWS/PwD candidates); must meet the relevant-course eligibility prescribed by the concerned university. GATE/GPAT-qualified candidates receive preference over non-qualified candidates, followed by candidates who did not appear for GATE/GPAT. (Official source: SBJITMR Mandatory Disclosure 2024-25 — https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Mandatory-Disclosure-2024-25-Final.pdf)

questions: What is the MBA admission process and eligibility at SBJITMR?
answer: For AY 2024-25, MBA admissions at SBJITMR, Nagpur accept scores in MAH-MBA/MMS-CET, CAT, CMAT, XAT, ATMA, MAT and GMAT. Eligibility (Maharashtra state candidature): Indian citizen; a minimum three-year bachelor degree in any discipline from a UGC or AIU recognized university with at least 50% aggregate/equivalent (45% for the stated Maharashtra State reserved-category/EWS/PwD candidates); a non-zero score in MAH-MBA/MMS-CET 2024. All-India/Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh migrant candidature: same degree requirement plus a non-zero positive score in one of the listed exams. (Official source: SBJITMR Mandatory Disclosure 2024-25 — https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Mandatory-Disclosure-2024-25-Final.pdf)

questions: How do I submit my exam form at SBJITMR?
Exam form registration
How to submit exam form
answer: Exam forms at SBJITMR, Nagpur are submitted online: go to the college website, Exam Cell, then Exam Form Registration. For first login, use your USN/PRN as both Login ID and Password, then change the password and log in again. Regular students use Exam Registration to check registered courses; backlog students use Backlog Course Registration to select courses. Check the applicable examination fees, accept the agreement, and pay via UPI/scanner, cards or net banking. After successful payment, download/print the examination form and fee receipt, sign both, and submit them to the respective department. Backlog students must submit a separate examination form for each semester. Forms and fees must be submitted by the notified dates; late and super-late fees apply after the normal deadline, and forms are not accepted after the super-late-fee deadline. (Official sources: https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ONLINE-EXAMINATION-FORM-SUBMISSION-PROCESS.pdf; https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/SBJIT-Exam-Manual_2023-%E2%80%93-24-NEP.pdf)

questions: How does the revaluation process work at SBJITMR?
Revaluation process
Open day process
answer: If you are dissatisfied with your End Semester Examination valuation at SBJITMR, Nagpur, first raise specific points with the course faculty during the published transparency/Open Day process. For an unvalued answer or an error in totaling marks, submit Grievance Form 1 to the Student Section. For revision of marks/reassessment, submit Grievance Form 2 to the Student Section after paying the prescribed fee; a valuer other than the first valuer then re-evaluates the answer sheet. Revaluated marks become final only if the difference is at least +/-5% of the total marks of that examination; otherwise there is no change in marks. Applications must be submitted by the dates in the COE notification. The exact revaluation fee amount is not published on the official pages. (Official sources: https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/SBJIT-Exam-Manual_2023-%E2%80%93-24-NEP.pdf; https://www.sbjit.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/14.Open-Day-MBA-I-Sem_Resit-Winter-24.pdf)

Yes, diploma holders can take admission directly into the second year of B.Tech (Lateral Entry / DSY) at S. B. Jain Institute of Technology, Management & Research (SBJITMR), Nagpur (DTE Code: 4197).
